test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum of money invested at x% simple interest per annum amounts to Rs. 2,368 in 6 years and to Rs. 3,008 in 11 years. Find the value of x.
solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 6 years = Rs. 2,368

Amount after 11 years = Rs. 3,008

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Let Principal be P and Rate be x%.

From the given data:

P + (P × x × 6) / 100 = 2368......(1)

P + (P × x × 11) / 100 = 3008.....(2)
